titleEn: Maximum Sum of Almost Unique Subarray
title: 几乎唯一子数组的最大和
summary: 在整数列表中找长度恰为 k 且至少含 m 个不同元素的子数组，返回最大元素和，不存在返回零。
insight: 固定长度滑动窗口同时维护元素和与频次表。加入右端、窗口超过 k 时移出左端；窗口长度为 k 且频次表大小至少 m 时更新最大和。
pitfalls: 窗口长度必须恰好为 k
条件是至少 m 种不同元素
频次降为零时要从表中删除

solutions.title: 定长窗口频次与和
solutions.idea: 线性维护每个长度 k 窗口的不同值数和总和。
steps: 若窗口超过 k，移出 right-k
窗口形成且 frequency.size>=m 时更新 answer

code.java: class Solution { public long maxSum(List<Integer> nums,int m,int k){Map<Integer,Integer> frequency=new HashMap<>();long sum=0,answer=0;for(int right=0;right<nums.size();right++){int value=nums.get(right);sum+=value;frequency.put(value,frequency.getOrDefault(value,0)+1);if(right>=k){int removed=nums.get(right-k);sum-=removed;int count=frequency.get(removed)-1;if(count==0)frequency.remove(removed);else frequency.put(removed,count);}if(right>=k-1&&frequency.size()>=m)answer=Math.max(answer,sum);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxSum(nums:List<Int>,m:Int,k:Int):Long{val frequency=HashMap<Int,Int>();var sum=0L;var answer=0L;for(right in nums.indices){val value=nums[right];sum+=value;frequency[value]=(frequency[value]?:0)+1;if(right>=k){val removed=nums[right-k];sum-=removed;val count=frequency[removed]!!-1;if(count==0)frequency.remove(removed) else frequency[removed]=count};if(right>=k-1&&frequency.size>=m)answer=maxOf(answer,sum)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:long long maxSum(vector<int>& nums,int m,int k){unordered_map<int,int> frequency;long long sum=0,answer=0;for(int right=0;right<(int)nums.size();++right){int value=nums[right];sum+=value;++frequency[value];if(right>=k){int removed=nums[right-k];sum-=removed;if(--frequency[removed]==0)frequency.erase(removed);}if(right>=k-1&&(int)frequency.size()>=m)answer=max(answer,sum);}return answer;} };
